attributes.mlflow.spanInputs: {"question": "I need to get into my account urgently. What information do you need to verify me?"}
attributes.mlflow.spanOutputs:
"I can help with that. Per our account recovery process, I can verify you right here in chat so you don't have to wait for the standard two-business-day process. To do that, I need one of the following:

- **Your current password**, or
- **The 6-digit code** from your authenticator app

Please send one of those and I'll verify you. Once you're verified, I can reset your 2FA, unlock your account, or update your email, and you'll be able to sign in right after.

A couple of quick notes:
- Please only share your password or code with me in this chat. Acme staff will never ask for it by email or phone.
- If you've been locked out after 5 failed login attempts, the lock lasts 30 minutes.

What's going on with your account: are you locked out, or did you lose access to your 2FA device?"
